name: identity_role_assignments
description: Internal IA-MNS roles assigned to a Person. owner is the principal administrator with full IA-MNS capability and administration, independent of Sankhya or PDT roles.
lifecycle: Assigned by bootstrap or an existing owner with recent strong authentication; the last active owner cannot be removed. Every change is audited.

columns.Meaning: Owner Person who assigned the role.
columns.Null meaning: Assigned by the server-side bootstrap flow.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.Purpose: A role is assigned once per Person.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX identity_role_assignments_role_idx ON public.identity_role_assignments USING btree (role)
